project.name: Personal Documentation Site
project.summary: Publish a maintainable personal documentation site with search and a repeatable deployment path.
success_criteria: Responsive layout works on desktop and mobile

milestones.title: Publish a usable first version
milestones.description: Ship the content structure, navigation, search, and deployment guide.

milestones.title: Improve ongoing authoring
milestones.description: Add reusable content patterns and maintenance checks.

iterations.title: Foundation
iterations.goal: Establish the site structure and navigation.

iterations.title: Search and release
iterations.goal: Add search and publish the first public version.

work_items.title: Build the documentation foundation
work_items.description: Create the information architecture and site shell.

work_items.title: Create responsive navigation
work_items.description: Provide desktop and mobile navigation for the documentation tree.

acceptance_criteria.text: Desktop navigation exposes all top-level sections
Mobile navigation is usable at 360px width

work_items.title: Add site-wide search
work_items.description: Index published content and expose a search interface.
work_items.blocked_reason: Search indexing starts after the navigation structure is stable.

work_items.title: Fix mobile code-block overflow
work_items.description: Long code lines currently widen the mobile viewport.

acceptance_criteria.text: Long code lines scroll inside the block

work_items.title: Document local preview
work_items.description: Record the local build and preview workflow.
work_items.completion_note: Commands and the local preview URL were verified from a clean shell.

acceptance_criteria.text: At least two options are compared

risks.title: Search implementation adds maintenance burden
risks.description: A heavy search stack may be difficult for one maintainer to upgrade.
risks.mitigation: Prefer a static index and compare upgrade effort during the spike.

decisions.title: Use plain Markdown content
decisions.context: The site needs a durable authoring format with low migration cost.
decisions.decision: Keep source content in plain Markdown.
decisions.rationale: Markdown is portable, readable, and supported by many static-site tools.
decisions.consequences: Rich interactive components require a separate authoring pattern.
